recordType.description: Identifies the record as a header record.

fileName.description: Unique file name for this file type.

sourceId.description: Unique identifier associated with the source sending the file.

recordCount.description: Number of body records in the file.

scheduledWork.description: Collection of scheduled work records contained in the file.

employerCode.description: Represents employer code. Source note: From inbound Employer_code is coming but we are maintaining employer_id instead - Yes

scheduledTypeOfUnitsToWork.description: Represents scheduled type of units to work.

scheduledOfUnitsToWork.description: Represents scheduled of units to work.

unitsToWorkFrequency.description: Represents units to work frequency. Source note: How this field will be different from full time units? This will have scheduled frequency and mostly it will be same to full time units frequency? Do we need 2 different fields separately?

scheduledFullTimeUnitsFrequency.description: Represents scheduled full time units frequency. Source note: How this field will be different from scheduled units? This will have full time frequency and mostly it will be same to scheduled units frequency? Do we need 2 different fields separately?

unitsAnnuallyContractedToWork.description: Represents units annually contracted to work.

uniqueIdentifier.description: Represents unique identifier. Source note: Available in Inbound File but not in ER. Where are we planning to store the data? Available in employment history table as well, Do we need here?

sourceAssignmentId.description: Represents source assignment id. Source note: Available in Inbound File but not in ER. Where are we planning to store the data? Available in employment history table as well, Do we need here?

lastName.description: Represents last name. Source note: Available in Inbound File but not in ER. Where are we planning to store the data? Not needed. Can be traced through person id

firstName.description: Represents first name. Source note: Available in Inbound File but not in ER. Where are we planning to store the data? Not needed. Can be traced through person id
